purpose: Compare one, two and three known positive examples under fixed update budgets across the previously tested saved models; post-hoc diagnostic only

group_design.method: Python Random(42).shuffle indices0..8; partition into three triads; use all three pairs within each triad plus the triad itself

design.labels: all support labels1; no normal replay

linear.clip_convention: joint coefficient and intercept norm of mean support gradient

design.expert_policy: learned gates freeze original experts; fixed readouts combine separately adapted text experts and frozen URL
design.matched_controls: For each group S, re-evaluate every original one-example prediction supported on an element of S using heldout KISA outside ALL of S; for triples also re-evaluate all three within-triad pair outputs on identical triple-heldout cases. Never include a training row in gain.
design.neural_reset: original cached CPU weights, new AdamW and reset RNG per group; no chaining across support sizes

limitations: Known KISA cases selected from earlier DUP42 errors; every model own baseline differs.
This is a continuation selected after prior findings, not a prospective untouched test.
Only 9 of36 pairs and3 of84 triples; all cases covered evenly within each size but no exhaustive-combination claim.
Heldout denominators7 and6 change; matched controls explicitly exclude same support set.
Normal candidates199 train plus51 validation; source labels, not operational FPR.
Different family optimizers and input windows preclude architecture ranking.
Repeated model seeds, support groups and historical duplicate conditions are not independent observations.
Prior missing-weight, external JEV and URL HGB online-update exclusions remain unchanged.
